Patchset 2 (Gerrit 1884, commit e8838f98): addressed all 4 LLM-Review advisory findings from patchset 1 (PASS, non-blocking), two of which are AC-required:
- (scope-intent, AC) Added ADAPTER_BOUND_INTERNALS constant + test_adapter_bound_internals_are_not_contract_params (structural negative control) and annotated create-baseline as the behavioral negative control — proves source/return_alias/_creation_channel/repo_root produce no false divergence.
- (scope-intent, AC) Added test_oracle_detects_convergence: runs force-claim through today's real McpAdapter (asserts PARAM_NOT_EXPOSED) AND a parity-complete _ConvergedMcpAdapter (asserts ACCEPTED), proving in-suite that a closed gap flips the strict-xfail to xpass, forcing marker removal.
- (maintainability) Documented the concurrency row's deliberate OPEN-subject coupling on the Case row itself.
- (tests) Added unmutated_status to Case + a store-invariance guard: every REJECTED row now asserts the subject was left at its pre-op status, catching a rejection that leaked a partial write.
Local gates green: oracle 27 passed + 5 xfailed; make lint (ruff+format+complexity ratchet active=51 new=0 increased=0) + make typecheck (561 files) pass. Awaiting re-review + Verified on patchset 2.
